description: SEPMOD postprocesses heliospheric MHD simulations to estimate energetic-particle fluxes at a selected observer. The documented Fortran model uses shock and magnetic-field information from coupled solar-wind calculations. The resource is documented by University of California, Berkeley. The documented physical domain is Heliosphere / Inner Heliosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Runs-on-Request, Continuous/RT Run (SEP Scoreboard Intensity). A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. Results depend on the parent heliospheric simulation and selected event geometry. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
